key_insight: Detonation spraying parameters control titanium-dioxide-based coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, enabling process optimization for maximum water repellency.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle speed and spray-distance selection to tune coating surface characteristics.
method: Evaluate coating surface properties under varied detonation spraying conditions.
Relate roughness and thickness to nozzle travel speed using inverse power laws.
Relate roughness and contact angle to spray distance using parabolic laws.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports parameter-dependent relationships and optimal conditions for maximum hydrophobicity, but provides no numerical results or validation metrics.
watch_item: The applicability of the predictive equations beyond the tested process conditions cannot be assessed from the abstract.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
